about: The Workbench icons of the Wolf3D drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Wolf4SDL's own program icon (macosx/wolf4sdl.icns, its 128x128 picture). Wolf3D-drawer.info goes beside the drawer as Wolf3D.info (its own name here, as the program's wolf3d.info differs only in case).
